title: Log Analysis for LLM-Based Agents: A Lifecycle-Oriented Survey
abstract: arXiv:2611.23281v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Logs generated by LLM-based agents support analysis of execution behavior beyond final outputs. Existing surveys give limited attention to dependencies across the lifecycle of these records. A lifecycle-oriented review of 90 core studies published between 2024 and August 2026 covers Agent Logging, Agent Log Structuring, and Agent Log Mining. Stage-specific comparisons reveal cross-stage dependencies and limitations. Detailed logs do not necessarily provide sufficient evidence. Structural uniformity does not guarantee semantic equivalence. Analytical claims require alignment with supporting evidence, reference criteria, and validation procedures. Representative open-source tools, public datasets, and future research directions are also summarized.

translated_title: 面向基于大语言模型智能体的日志分析：一项生命周期导向的综述
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体所生成的日志能够支持超越最终输出的执行行为分析。现有综述对这些记录在整个生命周期中的跨阶段依赖关系关注有限。本文对2024年至2026年8月间发表的90项核心研究进行了生命周期导向的综述，涵盖智能体日志记录、智能体日志结构化与智能体日志挖掘三个阶段。针对各阶段的比较揭示了跨阶段的依赖关系与局限性：详细的日志未必能提供充分的证据；结构上的一致性并不保证语义上的等价性；分析性结论需要与支持证据、参考标准和验证程序保持一致。本文还总结了具有代表性的开源工具、公开数据集以及未来的研究方向。
tldr: 本文首次以生命周期视角系统综述了基于LLM智能体的日志分析领域，通过对90项核心研究的阶段划分与比较，揭示了日志记录、结构化与挖掘之间的跨阶段依赖关系，并指出详细日志未必证据充分、结构一致不等于语义等价等关键局限。
en_tdlr: This survey provides a lifecycle-oriented review of 90 core studies on log analysis for LLM-based agents—covering Agent Logging, Agent Log Structuring, and Agent Log Mining—revealing cross-stage dependencies and key limitations, such as that detailed logs do not guarantee sufficient evidence and structural uniformity does not ensure semantic equivalence.
